task.protocol: Events are chronological. Intermediate step acceptance validates draft fields and advances the form; it does not commit a submission. Intermediate progress followed by a submission error and an incomplete verifier result are compatible. Only a unique completed server submission with matching signed receipt proves completion. A temporary submission error with no commit permits one retry with unchanged supplied data and consent. Application received UI text alone never proves a commit.
